items.problem: Bootstrap omitted linked shared source, forcing error-prone shell reconstruction.
items.root_cause: Recursive filesystem copying did not honor legacy csproj Include/Link items.
items.change: Extend Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve common project path properties and copy linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/None items to their Link paths.
items.expected_effect: Shared XAML/code/assets enter mapping and transformation automatically, preserving source fidelity and avoiding reconstruction from obj.
items.falsifiable_check: Running bootstrap on TouchKeyboard copies App.xaml, MainPage.xaml, all four scenario XAML files, Styles/Styles.xaml, and shared assets without reading obj.

items.problem: Invalid GetForCurrentView calls survived a validator PASS and later emitted WUI0004.
items.evidence: lessons.json failed_apis and tools_problematic; build-output.txt lines 8-12
items.root_cause: The API-specific replacement was undocumented and validator residue checks excluded adaptable patterns.
items.change: Mark GetForCurrentView as mustResolve, validate such adaptable patterns without relying on analyzers, and document InputPane/CoreInputView as HWND interop cases with no projected factory.
items.expected_effect: Agents cannot delete a TODO and retain a compiling but runtime-invalid current-view call.
items.falsifiable_check: Validator reports FAIL for any non-deferred GetForCurrentView call even when Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Analyzers is absent; a rerun produces zero WUI0004 warnings.

items.problem: The documented compile command did not exist.
items.root_cause: SKILL.md conflated winapp package/launch responsibilities with compilation.
items.change: Replace winapp build with native dotnet build and state that final build follows validator completion.
items.expected_effect: The first compile command works and avoids concurrent generated-XAML races.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun has no unrecognized winapp build error and the post-validation dotnet build exits successfully.
items.tier_3_justification: This is command-selection and sequencing guidance; no template or migration script can redefine the installed CLI's command surface.

deferred_to_human: Investigate the scoring harness's splash-only UWP baseline capture; it limited behavioral comparison but is an evaluation-instrument issue and must not be changed in the migration skill.
